packed-consumer.os: iOS and Android native Release builds
packed-consumer.summary: 345-file archive SHA-256 916e2ab81eb75e8dd12fa28512b0cd14c404b932fc062d18af6d4dbc53e537ab passed consumer TypeScript, both production bundles and both native Release builds from the 0.1.5 source. No Expo or navigation dependency.

ios-source-review.summary: Reviewed the 0.1.5 changes: new ALGMenuPanel (UIGlassEffect behind iOS 26 availability checks, UIBlurEffect/opaque fallback, a non-cancelling UIGestureRecognizer for row tracking, UISelectionFeedbackGenerator) and ALGLongPress (UILongPressGestureRecognizer; cancels React Native touches by toggling its touch handler recognizer) Fabric components, and UIContextMenuInteraction delegate open/close plus a per-corner preview path on ALGMenu. Android counterparts use public View APIs and React Native NativeGestureUtil. No private APIs or new runtime dependencies. Runtime evidence is recorded separately.

ios-swiftui-runtime.device: iPhone 17 Pro Max simulator; GitHub macOS runner iPhone simulator
ios-swiftui-runtime.summary: Release UI tests passed on 26.5: tab lifecycle and first tap, tab artwork and tints, icon buttons and programmatic menus, visual tiers, menu panel (placement, tap and press-slide-lift selection, lift off the panel, steady platter brightness), context menu with onOpen/onClose and its plain fallback. The GitHub device-test run passed the iOS job including the menu-panel test.

ios-fallback-runtime.summary: 0.1.5 on 18.6 in Release: menu panel (system-material look, full selection flow, steady brightness), context menu and plain fallback passed. Earlier 18.6 evidence (tab artwork and tints, visual tiers, tab lifecycle and navigation, pills, badges, toolbar and menus) is carried from 0.1.3; those paths are unchanged. iOS 15-17 remains unexecuted.
